{{Quote|The Killiks are stirring, legion upon legion. They've already devoured the armies of Qel-Nosh and Antilles.|[[Serjay Thul]]|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''House Qel-Nosh''' was a noble house of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. An army gathered by the house was absorbed by the [[Soros|Black Hive]] of [[Killik/Legends|Killiks]] along with an army of the [[House of Antilles|House Antilles]].<ref name="TOR" />
